Our "return policy" for rentals is:

Condition: Items must be returned in the same condition as received: no new damage, no permanent stains, unaltered, and structurally intact. Normal wear is fine; lenders handle standard cleaning.
Timing: Ship back on the last day of your rental using next‑day tracked delivery, so it reaches the lender the following working day. You’re responsible for safe, insured return.
Poor condition on arrival: If your item arrives damaged or not as described, photograph it the day it arrives, message the lender immediately, and return it within 24 hours. Then submit a refund request in‑app.
Refunds:
If the rental doesn’t fit, refunds depend on the lender’s policy and are issued as app credit only, never cash.
You can request a refund in‑app if you return the item to the lender within 24 hours of receiving it; platform service fees aren’t refunded.
If an item arrives late (after the first rental day) and you don’t use it, you may be eligible for a full refund if you notify us immediately and return it within 24 hours.
Late returns: Returning after the final rental day can lead to late fees.
Damage on return: If you cause damage, the lender can arrange repair/cleaning and send you a Charge Request (with a service fee) via the app, which can go through a dispute process.

How do I start a return or an exchange?
To start a return, first follow what you agreed with the lender:
If posting back: Send the item on the last rental day via tracked next‑day delivery, and share tracking and proof of postage with the lender.
If there’s an issue (poor condition, misrepresented, wrong fit, or late arrival):
Photograph the item the day it arrives.
Message the lender immediately and, if unusable, return it within 24 hours.
In the app, open the rental, scroll down, and tap “Request Refund”, then enter the amount. Refunds are usually only possible if the item is returned within 24 hours and exclude platform fees.
For fit issues, any agreed refund is issued as By Rotation credit, not cash.
We don’t have a direct “exchange” flow—typically you’d return the first item (and request a refund if eligible), then place a new rental with another item.
If the lender doesn’t respond to your refund request within 72 hours or to an issue with condition, you should email help@byrotation.com with your rental details and photos so our team can step in. If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
